title: NTPC Ltd — General Updates
text: NTPC Limited has informed the Exchange about declaration of COD of second part capacity of 6.3 MW of Vanki Wind EnergyProject located in Nakhatrana, Kutch, Gujarat of NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, a stepdown subsidiary of NTPC Limited through NGEL
